failed_jobs.symptom: Build tokenizers wheel (Windows) step fails: pip cannot resolve build-dependency 'openvino~=2027.0.0.dev' from the pip-proxy index, which only serves up to 2026.5.1.dev20261116.

key_errors: ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement openvino~=2027.0.0.dev (from versions: ... 2026.4.0, 2026.4.1, 2026.5.1.dev20261116)
ERROR: No matching distribution found for openvino~=2027.0.0.dev
ERROR: Failed to build 'file:///C:/actions-runner/_work/openvino/openvino/openvino_tokenizers' when installing build dependencies
root_cause: The job_tokenizers.yml workflow clones openvino_tokenizers at the target branch (master) and builds its wheel using 'pip wheel ... .' on that checkout. The openvino_tokenizers pyproject.toml build-system requires 'openvino~=2027.0.0.dev', but the pip-proxy index used by CI only serves openvino builds up to 2026.5.1.dev20261116 (this repository's current dev version line). The openvino_tokenizers repository's declared openvino version constraint has advanced ahead of what this repository (and its mirrored package index) currently publishes, so pip's build-isolation step cannot resolve a matching build dependency and the wheel build aborts before compilation starts. This is a cross-repository version-pin desynchronization, not a code defect in this repository's commit.
reproduction_steps:
1. Checkout openvinotoolkit/openvino_tokenizers at its master branch.
2. Build an openvino wheel for this repo's master (version 2026.5.1.devYYYYMMDD) and place it in a local find-links directory.
3. Run: python -m pip wheel -v --no-deps --wheel-dir build --find-links <wheels-dir> --config-settings="override=cmake.build_args={...}" <openvino_tokenizers-checkout>
4. Observe pip's build-isolation step fail resolving 'openvino~=2027.0.0.dev' against the locally built 2026.5.1.dev wheel.
recommended_actions: Align the openvino version constraint in openvinotoolkit/openvino_tokenizers's pyproject.toml (build-system requires) with the openvino version actually published from this repository's current master (2026.5.x.dev), or bump this repo's VERSION if 2027.0.0 is the intended next line.

Add a CI guard/smoke check that compares the openvino version pin in openvino_tokenizers against the version produced by this repository's build, failing fast with a clear message instead of a cryptic pip resolution error.
Coordinate the openvino_tokenizers version bump with the owning team so it lands only after the corresponding openvino 2027.0.0.dev wheels are actually published to the pip-proxy index.
prevention_strategies: When bumping an open-ended '~=X.Y.dev' build dependency in a companion repository (openvino_tokenizers) ahead of the corresponding version bump/publish in this repository, gate the merge on a cross-repo CI check that verifies the pinned openvino version is resolvable in the current index before merging to master. Avoid merging version-bump commits into downstream repos' master until the upstream package is actually published.
historical_context: This exact signature has now recurred 4 times since 2026-11-06 (pattern 3006cd222bc46b05), including runs 43859635737, 43859635810, 42243497813, and this run, all on the same job_tokenizers.yml Windows build step. The recurring cause has consistently been the openvino_tokenizers repo's build-dependency version pin outstripping what this repository's package index serves; the underlying cross-repo desync has not yet been fixed upstream.
